page.notes: Left page strip is too dark and cut to transcribe reliably; the left-hand text is largely illegible. Right-hand lines are partly cut at the right edge and are incomplete. Hebrew words in the lines are rendered as illegible where not read with confidence. Doubtful readings are marked as illegible. The text is heavily blurred by show-through from the reverse, and the Hebrew words are largely unreadable, so they are marked illegible. The line breaks and paragraph divisions are uncertain. The letter at the foot is centred and may be a section mark. Right margin: faint notes near the top (about four short lines, partly illegible) and "Ver.19." beside the column lower down. Hebrew words in the column (for example at the line after "vulg. habi-") are not legible on this scan and are marked illegible. The left part of the column is heavily shadowed, so line starts are uncertain.
